name: DailyWindowGate
mechanic: Swaps clear only during a fixed 10-minute daily window (00:00-00:10 UTC); every other time reverts.
plain: This pool only lets swaps go through during a 10-minute window at the very start of each UTC day - from 00:00:00 up to, but not including, 00:10:00. At any other time a swap attempt reverts. Adding and removing liquidity is never blocked, so liquidity providers can enter or exit whenever they want and can never get locked in.
rules: Swaps succeed only when (block.timestamp mod 86400) is in [0, 600) - 00:00:00 to 00:10:00 UTC, open inclusive, close exclusive.
Every swap outside that daily 10-minute window reverts with TradingWindowClosed.
Liquidity add and remove are ungated at all times, so LPs are never locked.
